_meta.purpose: Per-model USD price per MILLION tokens for the v5.4 experiments (01_task_design.md §6). Each model is pinned to ONE fp8 provider via OpenRouter provider routing with fallbacks disabled (field 'provider').
_meta.source: OpenRouter public catalog and per-model endpoints, checked 2026-10-03 (runs/model_availability_2026-10-03.json) and 2026-10-04 (30B-A3B-Instruct-2507). Re-verify on the day of each run and record actual billed cost from the API response.
_meta.lines: Dense line = original hybrid-thinking Qwen3 (14B, 32B; '/no_think'). MoE line = 2507 non-thinking instruct releases (30B-A3B, 235B-A22B). Lines are analysed separately.
_meta.superseded: qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b (original hybrid, DeepInfra 0.12/0.50) replaced on 2026-10-04 by qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct-2507 so that the MoE pair shares one release. The 2026-09-28 price table is obsolete; Qwen3-8B and the original Qwen3-235B-A22B are listed for removal on 2026-10-09.
_meta.providers_2026_10_12: Provider pins revised after the desk smoke (02b v1.6 §14 A10): every pinned endpoint must accept tool_choice='required'. 32B -> Tenstorrent (the only endpoint that accepts it), 235B -> Parasail (accepts it, uptime 100%). Prices and context lengths from the OpenRouter endpoints API on 2026-10-12.
_meta.models_2026_10_17: Model set switched to the Mistral 3 family before any formal data (02b §14 D10): Ministral 3 3B / 8B / 14B (dense) and Mistral Large 3 (675B MoE, 41B active), all served by Mistral. Reason: every one has prompt caching (cached input at 10% of the input price), while Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-30B-A3B have no caching provider on OpenRouter; formal plan about $13 against about $34. The Qwen3 entries stay for the earlier smoke records. active_params_b of the Ministral models: nominal size; check the model cards before using the compute proxy.
